calls.title: Omar / August - AI Assistant sync
calls.summary: The meeting highlighted the launch of an AI assistant aimed at providing actionable support to users through a controlled rollout to select users. With a focus on modular skills defined in markdown files, the assistant will gradually gain functionality based on user feedback. The team seeks to consolidate multiple AI chat interfaces to streamline user experience while integrating robust monitoring capabilities to gather data for enhanced customer insights. Notably, plans include leveraging conversation data for improving customer support and potential sales insights, alongside a need for better escalation workflows between AI and human support.
calls.keywords: AI assistant, Skills, MongoDB transcripts, Feature flag, Support monitoring, Pylon API
calls.action_items:
**Omar Elshaikh**
Merge the AI assistant feature flag code into the main branch to enable early access for flagged users (01:20)
Provide August with notification when the AI assistant merge is complete so he can test the feature (01:42)
Share or demonstrate example AI assistant skills and possibly the skills repository to August for deeper understanding (02:32)
Explore and discuss potential UI/dashboard development for monitoring AI assistant conversations with Jeremy and the team (10:29)

**August Allard**
Follow up with Jeremy on prioritization of building internal tools/UI for conversation visibility and potential integration of AI assistant insights into sales and support workflows (10:47)
Coordinate with Omar on any future requirements or features to better track AI assistant conversations or improve escalation processes (11:40)
